key_facts: Swedish newspaper Aftonbladet reported on Wednesday, citing unnamed sources, that an AI agent deleted the edited second season of the Swedish version of MTV's The Challenge.
Production company Mastiff had reportedly given the agent access to its server; the finished edits were wiped with no way to recover them.
The season was weeks from its scheduled 22 Nov premiere; broadcaster TV4 confirmed it is now pushed to 2027.
TV4 programme director Mia Lindqvist said the backup did not work and the raw footage still exists, so the show must be recut.
TV4 later said its investigation found 'the human factor' at the production company, not AI, caused the loss.
quote_evidence: TV4 later told Aftonbladet that its investigation found the material disappeared because of "the human factor" at the production company and "not AI."
"In this case, the big problem is that their backup didn't work and that means they have to recut everything from scratch."
why_it_matters_hint: A real production delay where the cause (AI agent or human error and a failed backup) is contested.
event_date: Aftonbladet report dated Wednesday 14 Oct 2026; deletion date not stated
notes: Read via Gizmodo; Aftonbladet original not read. Unnamed sources; TV4 disputes AI cause.
title: AI Agent Reportedly Deletes an Entire Season of Reality TV Show
